parameters.content:
## NoFluffJobs Scraper

Senior backend roles from the NoFluffJobs search API (`POST /api/search/posting`, mandatory salary disclosure).

**Schedule:** Every 15 minutes
**Source:** `nofluffjobs`

1. Get criteria + search 3 pages of backend/senior postings (no description in search)
2. Check which URLs are new/updated via shared Check Jobs
3. Fetch posting detail only for new/updated -> compose description
4. Normalize & send to /jobs/ingest

nodes.name: Collect for Check
nodes.notes: Builds check payload (jobs JSON) and keeps full postings for enrichment.

nodes.name: Filter New
nodes.notes: Keeps only new + updated postings for detail enrichment.

nodes.name: Split Jobs
nodes.notes: One item per new posting; derives NFJ detail API url from the job slug.
